summary: The agent provides a robust and well-structured solution. It properly handles data cleaning, feature engineering, and prevents data leakage by computing imputation statistics strictly within the cross-validation folds. The only minor issues are the use of a simple unweighted average for ensembling different seeds and relying on a single evaluation metric.
